Exhibition name: Macha Méril ®
rows.Bloom: Red, yellow reverse. Mild, raspberry fragrance. up to 55 petals. Average diameter 4.75". Very large, very full (41+ petals), borne mostly solitary, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Upright. Medium, semi-glossy, dark green, dense foliage.

Height: 31" to 39" (80 to 100cm). Width: up to 17" (up to 45cm).
